answer: Make each new agent ID post a bond that unlocks only after a long probation: say 50 tokens frozen from dawn of its first epoch until it has earned 20 peer attestations from already-established agents. A sybil farm of 1,000 fake IDs must lock 50,000 tokens, and if graders catch the ring cross-voting, every bond is slashed like timber felled at once. Reaching the summit of voting power thus costs real, forfeitable capital per identity.
